Require Export cbpv.common.effects cbpv.common.coeffects cbpv.autosubst2.fintype.

Section Tm.

Inductive Tm (nTm : nat) : Type :=
  | var_Tm : (fin) (nTm) -> Tm (nTm)
  | abs : Q   -> Tm  ((S) nTm) -> Tm (nTm)
  | app : Tm  (nTm) -> Tm  (nTm) -> Tm (nTm)
  | unit : Tm (nTm)
  | seq : Tm  (nTm) -> Tm  (nTm) -> Tm (nTm)
  | inl : Tm  (nTm) -> Tm (nTm)
  | inr : Tm  (nTm) -> Tm (nTm)
  | prod : Tm  (nTm) -> Tm  (nTm) -> Tm (nTm)
  | fst : Tm  (nTm) -> Tm (nTm)
  | snd : Tm  (nTm) -> Tm (nTm)
  | case : Q   -> Tm  (nTm) -> Tm  ((S) nTm) -> Tm  ((S) nTm) -> Tm (nTm)
  | box : Q   -> Tm  (nTm) -> Tm (nTm)
  | unbox : Q   -> Tm  (nTm) -> Tm  ((S) nTm) -> Tm (nTm)
  | ret : Tm  (nTm) -> Tm (nTm)
  | bind : Q   -> Tm  (nTm) -> Tm  ((S) nTm) -> Tm (nTm)
  | coerce : Tm  (nTm) -> Tm (nTm)
  | tickT : Tm (nTm).

Definition upRen_Tm_Tm { m : nat } { n : nat } (xi : (fin) (m) -> (fin) (n)) : (fin) ((S) (m)) -> (fin) ((S) (n)) :=
  (up_ren) xi.

Fixpoint ren_Tm { mTm : nat } { nTm : nat } (xiTm : (fin) (mTm) -> (fin) (nTm)) (s : Tm (mTm)) : Tm (nTm) :=
    match s return Tm (nTm) with
    | var_Tm (_) s => (var_Tm (nTm)) (xiTm s)
    | abs (_) s0 s1 => abs (nTm) ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_Tm (upRen_Tm_Tm xiTm)) s1)
    | app (_) s0 s1 => app (nTm) ((ren_Tm xiTm) s0) ((ren_Tm xiTm) s1)
    | unit (_)  => unit (nTm)
    | seq (_) s0 s1 => seq (nTm) ((ren_Tm xiTm) s0) ((ren_Tm xiTm) s1)
    | inl (_) s0 => inl (nTm) ((ren_Tm xiTm) s0)
    | inr (_) s0 => inr (nTm) ((ren_Tm xiTm) s0)
    | prod (_) s0 s1 => prod (nTm) ((ren_Tm xiTm) s0) ((ren_Tm xiTm) s1)
    | fst (_) s0 => fst (nTm) ((ren_Tm xiTm) s0)
    | snd (_) s0 => snd (nTm) ((ren_Tm xiTm) s0)
    | case (_) s0 s1 s2 s3 => case (nTm) ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_Tm xiTm) s1) ((ren_Tm (upRen_Tm_Tm xiTm)) s2) ((ren_Tm (upRen_Tm_Tm xiTm)) s3)
    | box (_) s0 s1 => box (nTm) ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_Tm xiTm) s1)
    | unbox (_) s0 s1 s2 => unbox (nTm) ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_Tm xiTm) s1) ((ren_Tm (upRen_Tm_Tm xiTm)) s2)
    | ret (_) s0 => ret (nTm) ((ren_Tm xiTm) s0)
    | bind (_) s0 s1 s2 => bind (nTm) ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_Tm xiTm) s1) ((ren_Tm (upRen_Tm_Tm xiTm)) s2)
    | coerce (_) s0 => coerce (nTm) ((ren_Tm xiTm) s0)
    | tickT (_)  => tickT (nTm)
    end.

Definition up_Tm_Tm { m : nat } { nTm : nat } (sigma : (fin) (m) -> Tm (nTm)) : (fin) ((S) (m)) -> Tm ((S) nTm) :=
  (scons) ((var_Tm ((S) nTm)) (var_zero)) ((funcomp) (ren_Tm (shift)) sigma).

Fixpoint subst_Tm { mTm : nat } { nTm : nat } (sigmaTm : (fin) (mTm) -> Tm (nTm)) (s : Tm (mTm)) : Tm (nTm) :=
    match s return Tm (nTm) with
    | var_Tm (_) s => sigmaTm s
    | abs (_) s0 s1 => abs (nTm) ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_Tm (up_Tm_Tm sigmaTm)) s1)
    | app (_) s0 s1 => app (nTm) ((subst_Tm sigmaTm) s0) ((subst_Tm sigmaTm) s1)
    | unit (_)  => unit (nTm)
    | seq (_) s0 s1 => seq (nTm) ((subst_Tm sigmaTm) s0) ((subst_Tm sigmaTm) s1)
    | inl (_) s0 => inl (nTm) ((subst_Tm sigmaTm) s0)
    | inr (_) s0 => inr (nTm) ((subst_Tm sigmaTm) s0)
    | prod (_) s0 s1 => prod (nTm) ((subst_Tm sigmaTm) s0) ((subst_Tm sigmaTm) s1)
    | fst (_) s0 => fst (nTm) ((subst_Tm sigmaTm) s0)
    | snd (_) s0 => snd (nTm) ((subst_Tm sigmaTm) s0)
    | case (_) s0 s1 s2 s3 => case (nTm) ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_Tm sigmaTm) s1) ((subst_Tm (up_Tm_Tm sigmaTm)) s2) ((subst_Tm (up_Tm_Tm sigmaTm)) s3)
    | box (_) s0 s1 => box (nTm) ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_Tm sigmaTm) s1)
    | unbox (_) s0 s1 s2 => unbox (nTm) ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_Tm sigmaTm) s1) ((subst_Tm (up_Tm_Tm sigmaTm)) s2)
    | ret (_) s0 => ret (nTm) ((subst_Tm sigmaTm) s0)
    | bind (_) s0 s1 s2 => bind (nTm) ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_Tm sigmaTm) s1) ((subst_Tm (up_Tm_Tm sigmaTm)) s2)
    | coerce (_) s0 => coerce (nTm) ((subst_Tm sigmaTm) s0)
    | tickT (_)  => tickT (nTm)
    end.

End Tm.

Section Ty.

Inductive Ty  : Type :=
  | Unit : Ty
  | Sum : Ty   -> Ty   -> Ty
  | With : Ty   -> Ty   -> Ty
  | Abs : Q   -> Ty   -> Ty   -> Ty
  | Box : Q   -> Ty   -> Ty
  | Mon : E   -> Ty   -> Ty .

End Ty.

Arguments var_Tm {nTm}.

Arguments abs {nTm}.

Arguments app {nTm}.

Arguments unit {nTm}.

Arguments seq {nTm}.

Arguments inl {nTm}.

Arguments inr {nTm}.

Arguments prod {nTm}.

Arguments fst {nTm}.

Arguments snd {nTm}.

Arguments case {nTm}.

Arguments box {nTm}.

Arguments unbox {nTm}.

Arguments ret {nTm}.

Arguments bind {nTm}.

Arguments coerce {nTm}.

Arguments tickT {nTm}.

Global Instance Subst_Tm { mTm : nat } { nTm : nat } : Subst1 ((fin) (mTm) -> Tm (nTm)) (Tm (mTm)) (Tm (nTm)) := @subst_Tm (mTm) (nTm) .

Global Instance Ren_Tm { mTm : nat } { nTm : nat } : Ren1 ((fin) (mTm) -> (fin) (nTm)) (Tm (mTm)) (Tm (nTm)) := @ren_Tm (mTm) (nTm) .

Global Instance VarInstance_Tm { mTm : nat } : Var ((fin) (mTm)) (Tm (mTm)) := @var_Tm (mTm) .

Notation "x '__Tm'" := (var_Tm x) (at level 5, format "x __Tm") : subst_scope.

Notation "x '__Tm'" := (@ids (_) (_) VarInstance_Tm x) (at level 5, only printing, format "x __Tm") : subst_scope.

Notation "'var'" := (var_Tm) (only printing, at level 1) : subst_scope.

Class Up_Tm X Y := up_Tm : X -> Y.

Notation "↑__Tm" := (up_Tm) (only printing) : subst_scope.

Notation "↑__Tm" := (up_Tm_Tm) (only printing) : subst_scope.

Global Instance Up_Tm_Tm { m : nat } { nTm : nat } : Up_Tm (_) (_) := @up_Tm_Tm (m) (nTm) .

Notation "s [ sigmaTm ]" := (subst_Tm sigmaTm s) (at level 7, left associativity, only printing) : subst_scope.

Notation "[ sigmaTm ]" := (subst_Tm sigmaTm) (at level 1, left associativity, only printing) : fscope.

Notation "s ⟨ xiTm ⟩" := (ren_Tm xiTm s) (at level 7, left associativity, only printing) : subst_scope.

Notation "⟨ xiTm ⟩" := (ren_Tm xiTm) (at level 1, left associativity, only printing) : fscope.
Require Export full.CBN.syntax.

Definition contextL n := fin n -> Ty.

Inductive Wt {n} (γ : gradeVec n) (Γ : contextL n) : Tm n -> Ty -> Prop :=
    | T_var i :
        γ i = Qone ->
        (forall (j : fin n), j <> i -> γ j = Qzero) ->

        Wt γ Γ (var_Tm i) (Γ i)
    | T_abs q q' e T1 T2 :
        Wt (q .: γ) (T1 .: Γ) e T2 ->
        Qle q' q ->

        Wt γ Γ (abs q e) (Abs q' T1 T2)
    | T_app q e1 e2 T1 T2 γ1 γ2 :
        Wt γ1 Γ e1 (Abs q T1 T2) ->
        Wt γ2 Γ e2 T1 ->
        γ = γ1 Q+ (q Q* γ2) ->

        Wt γ Γ (app e1 e2) T2
    | T_unit :
        γ = (0s : gradeVec n) ->

        Wt γ Γ unit Unit
    | T_seq e1 e2 T γ1 γ2 :
        Wt γ1 Γ e1 Unit ->
        Wt γ2 Γ e2 T ->
        γ = γ1 Q+ γ2 ->

        Wt γ Γ (seq e1 e2) T
    | T_inl e T1 T2 :
        Wt γ Γ e T1 ->

        Wt γ Γ (inl e) (Sum T1 T2)
    | T_inr e T1 T2 :
        Wt γ Γ e T2 ->

        Wt γ Γ (inr e) (Sum T1 T2)
    | T_prod e1 e2 T1 T2 :
        Wt γ Γ e1 T1 ->
        Wt γ Γ e2 T2 ->

        Wt γ Γ (prod e1 e2) (With T1 T2)
    | T_fst e T1 T2 :
        Wt γ Γ e (With T1 T2) ->

        Wt γ Γ (fst e) T1
    | T_snd e T1 T2 :
        Wt γ Γ e (With T1 T2) ->

        Wt γ Γ (snd e) T2
    | T_case q e e1 e2 T1 T2 T γ1 γ2 :
        Wt γ1 Γ e (Sum T1 T2) ->
        Wt (q .: γ2) (T1 .: Γ) e1 T ->
        Wt (q .: γ2) (T2 .: Γ) e2 T ->
        γ = (q Q* γ1) Q+ γ2 ->
        Qle q Qone ->

        Wt γ Γ (case q e e1 e2) T
    | T_box q e T γ1 :
        Wt γ1 Γ e T ->
        γ = (q Q* γ1) ->

        Wt γ Γ (box q e) (Box q T)
    | T_unbox q1 q2 q2' e1 e2 T1 T2 γ1 γ2 :
        q2' = q_or_1 q2 ->
        Wt γ1 Γ e1 (Box q1 T1) ->
        Wt ((Qmult q1 q2') .: γ2) (T1 .: Γ) e2 T2 ->
        γ = (q2' Q* γ1) Q+ γ2 ->

        Wt γ Γ (unbox q2 e1 e2) T2
    | T_sub e T γ' :
        Wt γ' Γ e T ->
        γ Q<= γ' ->

        Wt γ Γ e T
    | T_ret e T :
        Wt γ Γ e T ->

        Wt γ Γ (ret e) (Mon ϵ T)
    | T_bind q' q e1 e2 T1 T2 γ1 γ2 ϕ1 ϕ2 ϕ :
        q' = q_or_1 q ->
        Wt γ1 Γ e1 (Mon ϕ1 T1) ->
        Wt (q' .: γ2) (T1 .: Γ) e2 (Mon ϕ2 T2) ->
        γ = (q' Q* γ1) Q+ γ2 ->
        ϕ1 E+ ϕ2 = ϕ ->

        Wt γ Γ (bind q e1 e2) (Mon ϕ T2)
    | T_coerce e T ϕ ϕ' :
        Wt γ Γ e (Mon ϕ T) ->
        ϕ E<= ϕ' ->

        Wt γ Γ (coerce e) (Mon ϕ' T)
    | T_tickT :
        γ = (0s : gradeVec n) ->

        Wt γ Γ tickT (Mon tick Unit).
Require Export full.CBPV.renaming.

Require Export full.CBN.typing.

From Coq Require Import FunctionalExtensionality.

Fixpoint translateType (T : Ty) : CompTy :=
    match T with
    | Unit => CF Qone VUnit
    | Sum T1 T2 =>
        CF Qone
            (VSum
                (VThunk ϵ (translateType T1))
                (VThunk ϵ (translateType T2)))
    | Abs q T1 T2 =>
        CAbs q
            (VThunk ϵ (translateType T1))
            (translateType T2)
    | Box q T =>
        CF q (VThunk ϵ (translateType T))
    | With T1 T2 =>
        CPair (translateType T1) (translateType T2)
    | Mon ϕ T => CF Qone (VThunk ϕ (CF Qone (VThunk ϵ (translateType T))))
    end.

Definition translateContext {n} (Γ : contextL n) : context n :=
    fun (i : fin n) => VThunk ϵ (translateType (Γ i)).

Fixpoint translateTerm {n} (e0 : Tm n) : Comp n :=
    match e0 with
    | var_Tm i => cForce (var_Val i)
    | abs q e => cAbs q (translateTerm e)
    | app e1 e2 =>
        cApp (translateTerm e1) (vThunk (translateTerm e2))
    | unit => cRet Qone vUnit
    | seq e1 e2 =>
        cLet Qone
            (translateTerm e1)
            (cSeq (var_Val var_zero) ((ren_Comp shift) (translateTerm e2)))
    | prod e1 e2 =>
        cPair (translateTerm e1) (translateTerm e2)
    | fst e => cFst (translateTerm e)
    | snd e => cSnd (translateTerm e)
    | inl e => cRet Qone (vInl (vThunk (translateTerm e)))
    | inr e => cRet Qone (vInr (vThunk (translateTerm e)))
    | case q e e1 e2 =>
        cLet q (translateTerm e)
            (cCase q (var_Val var_zero)
                ((ren_Comp up_ren') (translateTerm e1))
                ((ren_Comp up_ren') (translateTerm e2)))
    | box q e => cRet q (vThunk (translateTerm e))
    | unbox q e1 e2 =>
        cLet q (translateTerm e1) (translateTerm e2)
    | ret e => cRet Qone (vThunk (cRet Qone (vThunk (translateTerm e))))
    | bind q' e1 e2 =>
        let q := q_or_1 q' in

Definition contextL n := fin n -> Ty.

Inductive Wt {n} (γ : gradeVec n) (Γ : contextL n) : Tm n -> Ty -> Prop :=
    | T_var i :
        γ i = Qone ->
        (forall (j : fin n), j <> i -> γ j = Qzero) ->

        Wt γ Γ (var_Tm i) (Γ i)
    | T_abs q q' e T1 T2 :
        Wt (q .: γ) (T1 .: Γ) e T2 ->
        Qle q' q ->

        Wt γ Γ (abs q e) (Abs q' T1 T2)
    | T_app q e1 e2 T1 T2 γ1 γ2 :
        Wt γ1 Γ e1 (Abs q T1 T2) ->
        Wt γ2 Γ e2 T1 ->
        γ = γ1 Q+ (q Q* γ2) ->

        Wt γ Γ (app e1 e2) T2
    | T_unit :
        γ = (0s : gradeVec n) ->

        Wt γ Γ unit Unit
    | T_seq e1 e2 T γ1 γ2 :
        Wt γ1 Γ e1 Unit ->
        Wt γ2 Γ e2 T ->
        γ = γ1 Q+ γ2 ->

        Wt γ Γ (seq e1 e2) T
    | T_inl e T1 T2 :
        Wt γ Γ e T1 ->

        Wt γ Γ (inl e) (Sum T1 T2)
    | T_inr e T1 T2 :
        Wt γ Γ e T2 ->

        Wt γ Γ (inr e) (Sum T1 T2)
    | T_prod e1 e2 T1 T2 :
        Wt γ Γ e1 T1 ->
        Wt γ Γ e2 T2 ->

        Wt γ Γ (prod e1 e2) (With T1 T2)
    | T_fst e T1 T2 :
        Wt γ Γ e (With T1 T2) ->

        Wt γ Γ (fst e) T1
    | T_snd e T1 T2 :
        Wt γ Γ e (With T1 T2) ->

        Wt γ Γ (snd e) T2
    | T_case q e e1 e2 T1 T2 T γ1 γ2 :
        Wt γ1 Γ e (Sum T1 T2) ->
        Wt (q .: γ2) (T1 .: Γ) e1 T ->
        Wt (q .: γ2) (T2 .: Γ) e2 T ->
        γ = (q Q* γ1) Q+ γ2 ->
        Qle q Qone ->

        Wt γ Γ (case q e e1 e2) T
    | T_box q e T γ1 :
        Wt γ1 Γ e T ->
        γ = (q Q* γ1) ->

        Wt γ Γ (box q e) (Box q T)
    | T_unbox q1 q2 q2' e1 e2 T1 T2 γ1 γ2 :
        q2' = q_or_1 q2 ->
        Wt γ1 Γ e1 (Box q1 T1) ->
        Wt ((Qmult q1 q2') .: γ2) (T1 .: Γ) e2 T2 ->
        γ = (q2' Q* γ1) Q+ γ2 ->

        Wt γ Γ (unbox q2 e1 e2) T2
    | T_sub e T γ' :
        Wt γ' Γ e T ->
        γ Q<= γ' ->

        Wt γ Γ e T
    | T_ret e T :
        Wt γ Γ e T ->

        Wt γ Γ (ret e) (Mon ϵ T)
    | T_bind q' q e1 e2 T1 T2 γ1 γ2 ϕ1 ϕ2 ϕ :
        q' = q_or_1 q ->
        Wt γ1 Γ e1 (Mon ϕ1 T1) ->
        Wt (q' .: γ2) (T1 .: Γ) e2 (Mon ϕ2 T2) ->
        γ = (q' Q* γ1) Q+ γ2 ->
        ϕ1 E+ ϕ2 = ϕ ->

        Wt γ Γ (bind q e1 e2) (Mon ϕ T2)
    | T_coerce e T ϕ ϕ' :
        Wt γ Γ e (Mon ϕ T) ->
        ϕ E<= ϕ' ->

        Wt γ Γ (coerce e) (Mon ϕ' T)
    | T_tickT :
        γ = (0s : gradeVec n) ->

        Wt γ Γ tickT (Mon tick Unit).
Require Export full.CBPV.renaming.

Require Export full.CBN.typing.

From Coq Require Import FunctionalExtensionality.

Fixpoint translateType (T : Ty) : CompTy :=
    match T with
    | Unit => CF Qone VUnit
    | Sum T1 T2 =>
        CF Qone
            (VSum
                (VThunk ϵ (translateType T1))
                (VThunk ϵ (translateType T2)))
    | Abs q T1 T2 =>
        CAbs q
            (VThunk ϵ (translateType T1))
            (translateType T2)
    | Box q T =>
        CF q (VThunk ϵ (translateType T))
    | With T1 T2 =>
        CPair (translateType T1) (translateType T2)
    | Mon ϕ T => CF Qone (VThunk ϕ (CF Qone (VThunk ϵ (translateType T))))
    end.

Definition translateContext {n} (Γ : contextL n) : context n :=
    fun (i : fin n) => VThunk ϵ (translateType (Γ i)).

Fixpoint translateTerm {n} (e0 : Tm n) : Comp n :=
    match e0 with
    | var_Tm i => cForce (var_Val i)
    | abs q e => cAbs q (translateTerm e)
    | app e1 e2 =>
        cApp (translateTerm e1) (vThunk (translateTerm e2))
    | unit => cRet Qone vUnit
    | seq e1 e2 =>
        cLet Qone
            (translateTerm e1)
            (cSeq (var_Val var_zero) ((ren_Comp shift) (translateTerm e2)))
    | prod e1 e2 =>
        cPair (translateTerm e1) (translateTerm e2)
    | fst e => cFst (translateTerm e)
    | snd e => cSnd (translateTerm e)
    | inl e => cRet Qone (vInl (vThunk (translateTerm e)))
    | inr e => cRet Qone (vInr (vThunk (translateTerm e)))
    | case q e e1 e2 =>
        cLet q (translateTerm e)
            (cCase q (var_Val var_zero)
                ((ren_Comp up_ren') (translateTerm e1))
                ((ren_Comp up_ren') (translateTerm e2)))
    | box q e => cRet q (vThunk (translateTerm e))
    | unbox q e1 e2 =>
        cLet q (translateTerm e1) (translateTerm e2)
    | ret e => cRet Qone (vThunk (cRet Qone (vThunk (translateTerm e))))
    | bind q' e1 e2 =>
        let q := q_or_1 q' in
        cRet Qone (vThunk
        (cLet q
            (cLet Qone (translateTerm e1) (cForce (var_Val var_zero)))
            (cLet Qone (translateTerm e2) (cForce (var_Val var_zero)))))
    | coerce e =>
        cRet Qone (vThunk (cLet Qone (translateTerm e) (cForce (var_Val var_zero))))
    | tickT => cRet Qone (vThunk (cLet Qone cTick (cRet Qone (vThunk (cRet Qone (var_Val var_zero))))))
    end.

Require Export cbpv.common.effects cbpv.common.coeffects cbpv.autosubst2.fintype.

Section ValTyCompTy.

Inductive ValTy  : Type :=
  | VUnit : ValTy
  | VThunk : E   -> CompTy   -> ValTy
  | VPair : ValTy   -> ValTy   -> ValTy
  | VSum : ValTy   -> ValTy   -> ValTy
 with CompTy  : Type :=
  | CAbs : Q   -> ValTy   -> CompTy   -> CompTy
  | CF : Q   -> ValTy   -> CompTy
  | CPair : CompTy   -> CompTy   -> CompTy .

End ValTyCompTy.

Section ValComp.

Inductive Val (nVal : nat) : Type :=
  | var_Val : (fin) (nVal) -> Val (nVal)
  | vUnit : Val (nVal)
  | vThunk : Comp  (nVal) -> Val (nVal)
  | vPair : Val  (nVal) -> Val  (nVal) -> Val (nVal)
  | vInl : Val  (nVal) -> Val (nVal)
  | vInr : Val  (nVal) -> Val (nVal)
 with Comp (nVal : nat) : Type :=
  | cAbs : Q   -> Comp  ((S) nVal) -> Comp (nVal)
  | cApp : Comp  (nVal) -> Val  (nVal) -> Comp (nVal)
  | cForce : Val  (nVal) -> Comp (nVal)
  | cSplit : Q   -> Val  (nVal) -> Comp  ((S) ((S) nVal)) -> Comp (nVal)
  | cRet : Q   -> Val  (nVal) -> Comp (nVal)
  | cLet : Q   -> Comp  (nVal) -> Comp  ((S) nVal) -> Comp (nVal)
  | cPair : Comp  (nVal) -> Comp  (nVal) -> Comp (nVal)
  | cFst : Comp  (nVal) -> Comp (nVal)
  | cSnd : Comp  (nVal) -> Comp (nVal)
  | cSeq : Val  (nVal) -> Comp  (nVal) -> Comp (nVal)
  | cCase : Q   -> Val  (nVal) -> Comp  ((S) nVal) -> Comp  ((S) nVal) -> Comp (nVal)
  | cTick : Comp (nVal)
  | cLet0 : Comp  (nVal) -> Comp  ((S) nVal) -> Comp (nVal).

Definition upRen_Val_Val { m : nat } { n : nat } (xi : (fin) (m) -> (fin) (n)) : (fin) ((S) (m)) -> (fin) ((S) (n)) :=
  (up_ren) xi.

Fixpoint ren_Val { mVal : nat } { nVal : nat } (xiVal : (fin) (mVal) -> (fin) (nVal)) (s : Val (mVal)) : Val (nVal) :=
    match s return Val (nVal) with
    | var_Val (_) s => (var_Val (nVal)) (xiVal s)
    | vUnit (_)  => vUnit (nVal)
    | vThunk (_) s0 => vThunk (nVal) ((ren_Comp xiVal) s0)
    | vPair (_) s0 s1 => vPair (nVal) ((ren_Val xiVal) s0) ((ren_Val xiVal) s1)
    | vInl (_) s0 => vInl (nVal) ((ren_Val xiVal) s0)
    | vInr (_) s0 => vInr (nVal) ((ren_Val xiVal) s0)
    end
 with ren_Comp { mVal : nat } { nVal : nat } (xiVal : (fin) (mVal) -> (fin) (nVal)) (s : Comp (mVal)) : Comp (nVal) :=
    match s return Comp (nVal) with
    | cAbs (_) s0 s1 => cAbs (nVal) ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_Comp (upRen_Val_Val xiVal)) s1)
    | cApp (_) s0 s1 => cApp (nVal) ((ren_Comp xiVal) s0) ((ren_Val xiVal) s1)
    | cForce (_) s0 => cForce (nVal) ((ren_Val xiVal) s0)
    | cSplit (_) s0 s1 s2 => cSplit (nVal) ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_Val xiVal) s1) ((ren_Comp (upRen_Val_Val (upRen_Val_Val xiVal))) s2)
    | cRet (_) s0 s1 => cRet (nVal) ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_Val xiVal) s1)
    | cLet (_) s0 s1 s2 => cLet (nVal) ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_Comp xiVal) s1) ((ren_Comp (upRen_Val_Val xiVal)) s2)
    | cPair (_) s0 s1 => cPair (nVal) ((ren_Comp xiVal) s0) ((ren_Comp xiVal) s1)
    | cFst (_) s0 => cFst (nVal) ((ren_Comp xiVal) s0)
    | cSnd (_) s0 => cSnd (nVal) ((ren_Comp xiVal) s0)
    | cSeq (_) s0 s1 => cSeq (nVal) ((ren_Val xiVal) s0) ((ren_Comp xiVal) s1)
    | cCase (_) s0 s1 s2 s3 => cCase (nVal) ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_Val xiVal) s1) ((ren_Comp (upRen_Val_Val xiVal)) s2) ((ren_Comp (upRen_Val_Val xiVal)) s3)
    | cTick (_)  => cTick (nVal)
    | cLet0 (_) s0 s1 => cLet0 (nVal) ((ren_Comp xiVal) s0) ((ren_Comp (upRen_Val_Val xiVal)) s1)
    end.

Definition up_Val_Val { m : nat } { nVal : nat } (sigma : (fin) (m) -> Val (nVal)) : (fin) ((S) (m)) -> Val ((S) nVal) :=
  (scons) ((var_Val ((S) nVal)) (var_zero)) ((funcomp) (ren_Val (shift)) sigma).

Fixpoint subst_Val { mVal : nat } { nVal : nat } (sigmaVal : (fin) (mVal) -> Val (nVal)) (s : Val (mVal)) : Val (nVal) :=
    match s return Val (nVal) with
    | var_Val (_) s => sigmaVal s
    | vUnit (_)  => vUnit (nVal)
    | vThunk (_) s0 => vThunk (nVal) ((subst_Comp sigmaVal) s0)
    | vPair (_) s0 s1 => vPair (nVal) ((subst_Val sigmaVal) s0) ((subst_Val sigmaVal) s1)
    | vInl (_) s0 => vInl (nVal) ((subst_Val sigmaVal) s0)
    | vInr (_) s0 => vInr (nVal) ((subst_Val sigmaVal) s0)
    end
 with subst_Comp { mVal : nat } { nVal : nat } (sigmaVal : (fin) (mVal) -> Val (nVal)) (s : Comp (mVal)) : Comp (nVal) :=
    match s return Comp (nVal) with
    | cAbs (_) s0 s1 => cAbs (nVal) ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_Comp (up_Val_Val sigmaVal)) s1)
    | cApp (_) s0 s1 => cApp (nVal) ((subst_Comp sigmaVal) s0) ((subst_Val sigmaVal) s1)
    | cForce (_) s0 => cForce (nVal) ((subst_Val sigmaVal) s0)
    | cSplit (_) s0 s1 s2 => cSplit (nVal) ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_Val sigmaVal) s1) ((subst_Comp (up_Val_Val (up_Val_Val sigmaVal))) s2)
    | cRet (_) s0 s1 => cRet (nVal) ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_Val sigmaVal) s1)
    | cLet (_) s0 s1 s2 => cLet (nVal) ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_Comp sigmaVal) s1) ((subst_Comp (up_Val_Val sigmaVal)) s2)
    | cPair (_) s0 s1 => cPair (nVal) ((subst_Comp sigmaVal) s0) ((subst_Comp sigmaVal) s1)
    | cFst (_) s0 => cFst (nVal) ((subst_Comp sigmaVal) s0)
    | cSnd (_) s0 => cSnd (nVal) ((subst_Comp sigmaVal) s0)
    | cSeq (_) s0 s1 => cSeq (nVal) ((subst_Val sigmaVal) s0) ((subst_Comp sigmaVal) s1)
    | cCase (_) s0 s1 s2 s3 => cCase (nVal) ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_Val sigmaVal) s1) ((subst_Comp (up_Val_Val sigmaVal)) s2) ((subst_Comp (up_Val_Val sigmaVal)) s3)
    | cTick (_)  => cTick (nVal)
    | cLet0 (_) s0 s1 => cLet0 (nVal) ((subst_Comp sigmaVal) s0) ((subst_Comp (up_Val_Val sigmaVal)) s1)
    end.

End ValComp.

Arguments var_Val {nVal}.

Arguments vUnit {nVal}.

Arguments vThunk {nVal}.

Arguments vPair {nVal}.

Arguments vInl {nVal}.

Arguments vInr {nVal}.

Definition context n := fin n -> ValTy.

Inductive VWt {n} (γ : gradeVec n) (Γ : context n) : Val n -> ValTy -> Prop :=
| T_Var i :
  γ i = Qone ->
  (forall (j : fin n), j <> i -> γ j = Qzero) ->

  VWt γ Γ (var_Val i) (Γ i)

| T_Thunk M B ϕ :
  CWt γ Γ M B ϕ ->

  VWt γ Γ (vThunk M) (VThunk ϕ B)

| T_Unit :
  γ = (0s : gradeVec n) ->

  VWt γ Γ vUnit VUnit

| T_VPair V1 V2 A1 A2 γ1 γ2 :
  VWt γ1 Γ V1 A1 ->
  VWt γ2 Γ V2 A2 ->
  γ = γ1 Q+ γ2 ->

  VWt γ Γ (vPair V1 V2) (VPair A1 A2)

| T_Inl V A1 A2 :
  VWt γ Γ V A1 ->

  VWt γ Γ (vInl V) (VSum A1 A2)

| T_Inr V A1 A2 :
  VWt γ Γ V A2 ->

  VWt γ Γ (vInr V) (VSum A1 A2)

| T_VSub V A γ' :
  VWt γ' Γ V A ->
  γ Q<= γ' ->

  VWt γ Γ V A

with CWt {n} (γ : gradeVec n) (Γ : context n) : Comp n -> CompTy -> E -> Prop :=
 | T_Abs q q' M A B ϕ :
  CWt (q .: γ) (A .: Γ) M B ϕ ->
  Qle q' q ->

  CWt γ Γ (cAbs q M) (CAbs q' A B) ϕ

| T_App q M V A B γ1 γ2 ϕ :
  CWt γ1 Γ M (CAbs q A B) ϕ ->
  VWt γ2 Γ V A ->
  γ = γ1 Q+ (q Q* γ2) ->

  CWt γ Γ (cApp M V) B ϕ

| T_Force V B ϕ :
  VWt γ Γ V (VThunk ϕ B) ->

  CWt γ Γ (cForce V) B ϕ

| T_Split q V N A1 A2 B γ1 γ2 ϕ :
  VWt γ1 Γ V (VPair A1 A2) ->
  CWt (q .: (q .: γ2)) (A1 .: (A2 .: Γ)) N B ϕ ->
  γ = (q Q* γ1) Q+ γ2 ->

  CWt γ Γ (cSplit q V N) B ϕ

| T_Ret q V A γ1 ϕ :
  VWt γ1 Γ V A ->
  γ = q Q* γ1 ->
  ϕ = ϵ ->

  CWt γ Γ (cRet q V) (CF q A) ϕ

| T_Let q1 q2 q' M N A B γ1 γ2 ϕ1 ϕ2 ϕ :
  q' = q_or_1 q2 ->
  CWt γ1 Γ M (CF q1 A) ϕ1 ->
  CWt ((Qmult q1 q') .: γ2) (A .: Γ) N B ϕ2 ->
  γ = (q' Q* γ1) Q+ γ2 ->
  ϕ = ϕ1 E+ ϕ2 ->

  CWt γ Γ (cLet q2 M N) B ϕ

| T_CPair M1 M2 B1 B2 ϕ :
  CWt γ Γ M1 B1 ϕ ->
  CWt γ Γ M2 B2 ϕ ->

  CWt γ Γ (cPair M1 M2) (CPair B1 B2) ϕ

| T_Fst M B1 B2 ϕ :
  CWt γ Γ M (CPair B1 B2) ϕ ->

  CWt γ Γ (cFst M) B1 ϕ

| T_Snd M B1 B2 ϕ :
  CWt γ Γ M (CPair B1 B2) ϕ ->

  CWt γ Γ (cSnd M) B2 ϕ

| T_Seq V N B γ1 γ2 ϕ :
  VWt γ1 Γ V VUnit ->
  CWt γ2 Γ N B ϕ ->
  γ = γ1 Q+ γ2 ->

  CWt γ Γ (cSeq V N) B ϕ

| T_Case q V M1 M2 A1 A2 B γ1 γ2 ϕ :
  VWt γ1 Γ V (VSum A1 A2) ->
  CWt (q .: γ2) (A1 .: Γ) M1 B ϕ ->
  CWt (q .: γ2) (A2 .: Γ) M2 B ϕ ->
  γ = (q Q* γ1) Q+ γ2 ->
  Qle q Qone ->

  CWt γ Γ (cCase q V M1 M2) B ϕ

| T_Tick ϕ :
  γ = (0s : gradeVec n) ->
  ϕ = tick ->

  CWt γ Γ cTick (CF Qone VUnit) ϕ

| T_CSub M B γ' ϕ :
  CWt γ' Γ M B ϕ ->
  γ Q<= γ' ->

  CWt γ Γ M B ϕ

| T_SubEff M B ϕ ϕ' :
  CWt γ Γ M B ϕ ->
  ϕ E<= ϕ' ->

  CWt γ Γ M B ϕ'

| T_LetZero q1 M N A B γ1 γ2 ϕ2 ϕ :
  CWt γ1 Γ M (CF q1 A) ϵ ->
  CWt (Qzero .: γ2) (A .: Γ) N B ϕ2 ->
  γ = γ2 ->
  ϕ = ϕ2 ->

  CWt γ Γ (cLet0 M N) B ϕ

.

Scheme VWt_ind' := Induction for VWt Sort Prop
    with CWt_ind' := Induction for CWt Sort Prop.

Fixpoint ren_Val { mVal : nat } { nVal : nat } (xiVal : (fin) (mVal) -> (fin) (nVal)) (s : Val (mVal)) : Val (nVal) :=
    match s return Val (nVal) with
    | var_Val (_) s => (var_Val (nVal)) (xiVal s)

    | vThunk (_) s0 => vThunk (nVal) ((ren_Comp xiVal) s0)

    | vInl (_) s0 => vInl (nVal) ((ren_Val xiVal) s0)
    | vInr (_) s0 => vInr (nVal) ((ren_Val xiVal) s0)

 with ren_Comp { mVal : nat } { nVal : nat } (xiVal : (fin) (mVal) -> (fin) (nVal)) (s : Comp (mVal)) : Comp (nVal) :=
    match s return Comp (nVal) with
    | cAbs (_) s0 s1 => cAbs (nVal) ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_Comp (upRen_Val_Val xiVal)) s1)
    | cApp (_) s0 s1 => cApp (nVal) ((ren_Comp xiVal) s0) ((ren_Val xiVal) s1)
    | cForce (_) s0 => cForce (nVal) ((ren_Val xiVal) s0)

    | cTick (_)  => cTick (nVal)

    end.

Fixpoint subst_Val { mVal : nat } { nVal : nat } (sigmaVal : (fin) (mVal) -> Val (nVal)) (s : Val (mVal)) : Val (nVal) :=

    | vPair (_) s0 s1 => vPair (nVal) ((subst_Val sigmaVal) s0) ((subst_Val sigmaVal) s1)
    | vInl (_) s0 => vInl (nVal) ((subst_Val sigmaVal) s0)
    | vInr (_) s0 => vInr (nVal) ((subst_Val sigmaVal) s0)
    end
 with subst_Comp { mVal : nat } { nVal : nat } (sigmaVal : (fin) (mVal) -> Val (nVal)) (s : Comp (mVal)) : Comp (nVal) :=
    match s return Comp (nVal) with
    | cAbs (_) s0 s1 => cAbs (nVal) ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_Comp (up_Val_Val sigmaVal)) s1)
    | cApp (_) s0 s1 => cApp (nVal) ((subst_Comp sigmaVal) s0) ((subst_Val sigmaVal) s1)
    | cForce (_) s0 => cForce (nVal) ((subst_Val sigmaVal) s0)
    | cSplit (_) s0 s1 s2 => cSplit (nVal) ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_Val sigmaVal) s1) ((subst_Comp (up_Val_Val (up_Val_Val sigmaVal))) s2)
    | cRet (_) s0 s1 => cRet (nVal) ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_Val sigmaVal) s1)
    | cLet (_) s0 s1 s2 => cLet (nVal) ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_Comp sigmaVal) s1) ((subst_Comp (up_Val_Val sigmaVal)) s2)
    | cPair (_) s0 s1 => cPair (nVal) ((subst_Comp sigmaVal) s0) ((subst_Comp sigmaVal) s1)
    | cFst (_) s0 => cFst (nVal) ((subst_Comp sigmaVal) s0)
    | cSnd (_) s0 => cSnd (nVal) ((subst_Comp sigmaVal) s0)
    | cSeq (_) s0 s1 => cSeq (nVal) ((subst_Val sigmaVal) s0) ((subst_Comp sigmaVal) s1)
    | cCase (_) s0 s1 s2 s3 => cCase (nVal) ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_Val sigmaVal) s1) ((subst_Comp (up_Val_Val sigmaVal)) s2) ((subst_Comp (up_Val_Val sigmaVal)) s3)
    | cTick (_)  => cTick (nVal)
    | cLet0 (_) s0 s1 => cLet0 (nVal) ((subst_Comp sigmaVal) s0) ((subst_Comp (up_Val_Val sigmaVal)) s1)

  γ = (0s : gradeVec n) ->
  ϕ = tick ->

  CWt γ Γ cTick (CF Qone VUnit) ϕ

  CWt γ' Γ M B ϕ ->

  CWt γ Γ M B ϕ

| T_SubEff M B ϕ ϕ' :
  CWt γ Γ M B ϕ ->
  ϕ E<= ϕ' ->

  CWt γ Γ M B ϕ'

  CWt γ1 Γ M (CF q1 A) ϵ ->
  CWt (Qzero .: γ2) (A .: Γ) N B ϕ2 ->

Definition contextL n := fin n -> Ty.

Inductive Wt {n} (γ : gradeVec n) (Γ : contextL n) : Tm n -> Ty -> Prop :=
    | T_var i :
        γ i = Qone ->
        (forall (j : fin n), j <> i -> γ j = Qzero) ->

        Wt γ Γ (var_Tm i) (Γ i)
    | T_abs q q' e T1 T2 :
        Wt (q .: γ) (T1 .: Γ) e T2 ->
        Qle q' q ->

        Wt γ Γ (abs q e) (Abs q' T1 T2)
    | T_app q q' e1 e2 T1 T2 γ1 γ2 :
        q' = q_or_1 q ->
        Wt γ1 Γ e1 (Abs q' T1 T2) ->
        Wt γ2 Γ e2 T1 ->
        γ = γ1 Q+ (q' Q* γ2) ->

        Wt γ Γ (app q e1 e2) T2
    | T_unit :
        γ = (0s : gradeVec n) ->

        Wt γ Γ unit Unit
    | T_seq e1 e2 T γ1 γ2 :
        Wt γ1 Γ e1 Unit ->
        Wt γ2 Γ e2 T ->
        γ = γ1 Q+ γ2 ->

        Wt γ Γ (seq e1 e2) T
    | T_pair e1 e2 T1 T2 γ1 γ2 :
        Wt γ1 Γ e1 T1 ->
        Wt γ2 Γ e2 T2 ->
        γ = γ1 Q+ γ2 ->

        Wt γ Γ (pair e1 e2) (Pair T1 T2)
    | T_split q q' e1 e2 T1 T2 γ1 γ2 :
        q' = q_or_1 q ->
        Wt γ1 Γ e1 (Pair T1 T2) ->
        Wt (q' .: (q' .: γ2)) (T1 .: (T2 .: Γ)) e2 T2 ->
        γ = (q' Q* γ1) Q+ γ2 ->

        Wt γ Γ (split q e1 e2) T2
    | T_inl e T1 T2 :
        Wt γ Γ e T1 ->

        Wt γ Γ (inl e) (Sum T1 T2)
    | T_inr e T1 T2 :
        Wt γ Γ e T2 ->

        Wt γ Γ (inr e) (Sum T1 T2)
    | T_case q e e1 e2 T1 T2 T γ1 γ2 :
        Wt γ1 Γ e (Sum T1 T2) ->
        Wt (q .: γ2) (T1 .: Γ) e1 T ->
        Wt (q .: γ2) (T2 .: Γ) e2 T ->
        γ = (q Q* γ1) Q+ γ2 ->
        Qle q Qone ->

        Wt γ Γ (case q e e1 e2) T
    | T_box q q' e T γ1 :
        q' = q_or_1 q ->
        Wt γ1 Γ e T ->
        γ = (q' Q* γ1) ->

        Wt γ Γ (box q e) (Box q' T)
    | T_unbox q1 q2 q' e1 e2 T1 T2 γ1 γ2 :
        q' = q_or_1 q2 ->
        Wt γ1 Γ e1 (Box q1 T1) ->
        Wt ((Qmult q1 q') .: γ2) (T1 .: Γ) e2 T2 ->
        γ = (q' Q* γ1) Q+ γ2 ->

        Wt γ Γ (unbox q2 e1 e2) T2
    | T_sub e T γ' :
        Wt γ' Γ e T ->
        γ Q<= γ' ->

        Wt γ Γ e T
    | T_ret e T ϕ :
        Wt γ Γ e T ->
        ϕ = ϵ ->

        Wt γ Γ (ret e) (Mon ϕ T)
    | T_bind q' q e1 e2 T1 T2 γ1 γ2 ϕ1 ϕ2 ϕ :
        q' = q_or_1 q ->
        Wt γ1 Γ e1 (Mon ϕ1 T1) ->
        Wt (q' .: γ2) (T1 .: Γ) e2 (Mon ϕ2 T2) ->
        γ = (q' Q* γ1) Q+ γ2 ->
        ϕ = ϕ1 E+ ϕ2 ->

        Wt γ Γ (bind q e1 e2) (Mon ϕ T2)
    | T_coerce e T ϕ ϕ' :
        Wt γ Γ e (Mon ϕ T) ->
        ϕ E<= ϕ' ->

        Wt γ Γ (coerce e) (Mon ϕ' T)
    | T_tickT :
        γ = (0s : gradeVec n) ->

        Wt γ Γ tickT (Mon tick Unit).

Fixpoint translateType (T : Ty) : ValTy :=
    match T with
    | Unit => VUnit
    | Pair T1 T2 => VPair (translateType T1) (translateType T2)
    | Sum T1 T2 => VSum (translateType T1) (translateType T2)
    | Abs q T1 T2 =>
        VThunk ϵ (CAbs q (translateType T1) (CF Qone (translateType T2)))
    | Box q T => VThunk ϵ (CF q (translateType T))
    | Mon ϕ T => VThunk ϕ (CF Qone (translateType T))
    end.

Definition translateContext {n} (Γ : contextL n) : context n :=
    fun (i : fin n) => translateType (Γ i).

Fixpoint translateTerm {n} (e0 : Tm n) : Comp n :=
     match e0 with
    | var_Tm i => cRet Qone (var_Val i)
    | abs q e => cRet Qone (vThunk (cAbs q (translateTerm e)))
    | app q e1 e2 =>
        cLet Qone
            (translateTerm e1)
            (cLet q
                ((ren_Comp shift) (translateTerm e2))
                (cApp
                    (cForce (var_Val (shift var_zero)))
                    (var_Val var_zero)))
    | unit => cRet Qone vUnit
    | seq e1 e2 =>
        cLet Qone
            (translateTerm e1)
            (cSeq (var_Val var_zero) ((ren_Comp shift) (translateTerm e2)))
    | pair e1 e2 =>
        cLet Qone
            (translateTerm e1)
            (cLet Qone
                ((ren_Comp shift) (translateTerm e2))
                (cRet Qone (vPair (var_Val (shift var_zero)) (var_Val var_zero))))
    | split q' e1 e2 => let q := q_or_1 q' in
        cLet q
            (translateTerm e1)
            (cSplit q (var_Val var_zero) ((ren_Comp up2_ren') (translateTerm e2)))
    | inl e => cLet Qone (translateTerm e) (cRet Qone (vInl (var_Val var_zero)))
    | inr e => cLet Qone (translateTerm e) (cRet Qone (vInr (var_Val var_zero)))
    | case q e e1 e2 =>
        cLet q
            (translateTerm e)
            (cCase q (var_Val var_zero)
                ((ren_Comp up_ren') (translateTerm e1))
                ((ren_Comp up_ren') (translateTerm e2)))
    | box q e =>
        let q' := q_or_1 q in
        cLet q (translateTerm e)
             (cRet Qone (vThunk (cRet q' (var_Val var_zero))))
    | unbox q e1 e2 =>
        cLet q
            (translateTerm e1)
            (cLet q
                    (cForce (var_Val var_zero))
                    ((ren_Comp up_ren') (translateTerm e2)))
    | ret e => cRet Qone (vThunk (translateTerm e))
    | bind q e1 e2 =>
        cRet Qone (vThunk
            (cLet q (cLet Qone (translateTerm e1) (cForce (var_Val var_zero)))
            (cLet Qone (translateTerm e2)
            (cForce (var_Val var_zero)))))
    | coerce e =>
        cRet Qone (vThunk (cLet Qone (translateTerm e) (cForce (var_Val var_zero))))
    | tickT => cRet Qone (vThunk (cLet Qone cTick (cRet Qone (var_Val var_zero))))
    end.

Notation "↑__Tm" := (up_Tm) (only printing) : subst_scope.

Notation "↑__Tm" := (up_Tm_Tm) (only printing) : subst_scope.

Global Instance Up_Tm_Tm { m : nat } { nTm : nat } : Up_Tm (_) (_) := @up_Tm_Tm (m) (nTm) .

Notation "s [ sigmaTm ]" := (subst_Tm sigmaTm s) (at level 7, left associativity, only printing) : subst_scope.

Notation "[ sigmaTm ]" := (subst_Tm sigmaTm) (at level 1, left associativity, only printing) : fscope.

Notation "s ⟨ xiTm ⟩" := (ren_Tm xiTm s) (at level 7, left associativity, only printing) : subst_scope.

Notation "⟨ xiTm ⟩" := (ren_Tm xiTm) (at level 1, left associativity, only printing) : fscope.
Require Export full.CBV.syntax.

Definition contextL n := fin n -> Ty.

Inductive Wt {n} (γ : gradeVec n) (Γ : contextL n) : Tm n -> Ty -> Prop :=
    | T_var i :
        γ i = Qone ->
        (forall (j : fin n), j <> i -> γ j = Qzero) ->

        Wt γ Γ (var_Tm i) (Γ i)
    | T_abs q q' e T1 T2 :
        Wt (q .: γ) (T1 .: Γ) e T2 ->
        Qle q' q ->

        Wt γ Γ (abs q e) (Abs q' T1 T2)
    | T_app q q' e1 e2 T1 T2 γ1 γ2 :
        q' = q_or_1 q ->
        Wt γ1 Γ e1 (Abs q' T1 T2) ->
        Wt γ2 Γ e2 T1 ->
        γ = γ1 Q+ (q' Q* γ2) ->

        Wt γ Γ (app q e1 e2) T2
    | T_unit :
        γ = (0s : gradeVec n) ->

        Wt γ Γ unit Unit
    | T_seq e1 e2 T γ1 γ2 :
        Wt γ1 Γ e1 Unit ->
        Wt γ2 Γ e2 T ->
        γ = γ1 Q+ γ2 ->

        Wt γ Γ (seq e1 e2) T
    | T_pair e1 e2 T1 T2 γ1 γ2 :
        Wt γ1 Γ e1 T1 ->
        Wt γ2 Γ e2 T2 ->
        γ = γ1 Q+ γ2 ->

        Wt γ Γ (pair e1 e2) (Pair T1 T2)
    | T_split q q' e1 e2 T1 T2 γ1 γ2 :
        q' = q_or_1 q ->
        Wt γ1 Γ e1 (Pair T1 T2) ->
        Wt (q' .: (q' .: γ2)) (T1 .: (T2 .: Γ)) e2 T2 ->
        γ = (q' Q* γ1) Q+ γ2 ->

        Wt γ Γ (split q e1 e2) T2
    | T_inl e T1 T2 :
        Wt γ Γ e T1 ->

        Wt γ Γ (inl e) (Sum T1 T2)
    | T_inr e T1 T2 :
        Wt γ Γ e T2 ->

        Wt γ Γ (inr e) (Sum T1 T2)
    | T_case q e e1 e2 T1 T2 T γ1 γ2 :
        Wt γ1 Γ e (Sum T1 T2) ->
        Wt (q .: γ2) (T1 .: Γ) e1 T ->
        Wt (q .: γ2) (T2 .: Γ) e2 T ->
        γ = (q Q* γ1) Q+ γ2 ->
        Qle q Qone ->

        Wt γ Γ (case q e e1 e2) T
    | T_box q q' e T γ1 :
        q' = q_or_1 q ->
        Wt γ1 Γ e T ->
        γ = (q' Q* γ1) ->

        Wt γ Γ (box q e) (Box q' T)
    | T_unbox q1 q2 q' e1 e2 T1 T2 γ1 γ2 :
        q' = q_or_1 q2 ->
        Wt γ1 Γ e1 (Box q1 T1) ->
        Wt ((Qmult q1 q') .: γ2) (T1 .: Γ) e2 T2 ->
        γ = (q' Q* γ1) Q+ γ2 ->

        Wt γ Γ (unbox q2 e1 e2) T2
    | T_sub e T γ' :
        Wt γ' Γ e T ->
        γ Q<= γ' ->

        Wt γ Γ e T
    | T_ret e T ϕ :
        Wt γ Γ e T ->
        ϕ = ϵ ->

        Wt γ Γ (ret e) (Mon ϕ T)
    | T_bind q' q e1 e2 T1 T2 γ1 γ2 ϕ1 ϕ2 ϕ :
        q' = q_or_1 q ->
        Wt γ1 Γ e1 (Mon ϕ1 T1) ->
        Wt (q' .: γ2) (T1 .: Γ) e2 (Mon ϕ2 T2) ->
        γ = (q' Q* γ1) Q+ γ2 ->
        ϕ = ϕ1 E+ ϕ2 ->

        Wt γ Γ (bind q e1 e2) (Mon ϕ T2)
    | T_coerce e T ϕ ϕ' :
        Wt γ Γ e (Mon ϕ T) ->
        ϕ E<= ϕ' ->

        Wt γ Γ (coerce e) (Mon ϕ' T)
    | T_tickT :
        γ = (0s : gradeVec n) ->

        Wt γ Γ tickT (Mon tick Unit).
Require Export full.CBPV.renaming.

Require Export full.CBV.typing.

From Coq Require Import FunctionalExtensionality.

Fixpoint translateType (T : Ty) : ValTy :=
    match T with
    | Unit => VUnit
    | Pair T1 T2 => VPair (translateType T1) (translateType T2)
    | Sum T1 T2 => VSum (translateType T1) (translateType T2)
    | Abs q T1 T2 =>
        VThunk ϵ (CAbs q (translateType T1) (CF Qone (translateType T2)))
    | Box q T => VThunk ϵ (CF q (translateType T))
    | Mon ϕ T => VThunk ϕ (CF Qone (translateType T))
    end.

Definition translateContext {n} (Γ : contextL n) : context n :=
    fun (i : fin n) => translateType (Γ i).

Fixpoint translateTerm {n} (e0 : Tm n) : Comp n :=
     match e0 with
    | var_Tm i => cRet Qone (var_Val i)
    | abs q e => cRet Qone (vThunk (cAbs q (translateTerm e)))
    | app q e1 e2 =>
        cLet Qone
            (translateTerm e1)
            (cLet q
                ((ren_Comp shift) (translateTerm e2))
                (cApp
                    (cForce (var_Val (shift var_zero)))
                    (var_Val var_zero)))
    | unit => cRet Qone vUnit
    | seq e1 e2 =>
        cLet Qone
            (translateTerm e1)
            (cSeq (var_Val var_zero) ((ren_Comp shift) (translateTerm e2)))
    | pair e1 e2 =>
        cLet Qone
            (translateTerm e1)
            (cLet Qone
                ((ren_Comp shift) (translateTerm e2))
                (cRet Qone (vPair (var_Val (shift var_zero)) (var_Val var_zero))))
    | split q' e1 e2 => let q := q_or_1 q' in
        cLet q
            (translateTerm e1)
            (cSplit q (var_Val var_zero) ((ren_Comp up2_ren') (translateTerm e2)))
    | inl e => cLet Qone (translateTerm e) (cRet Qone (vInl (var_Val var_zero)))
    | inr e => cLet Qone (translateTerm e) (cRet Qone (vInr (var_Val var_zero)))
    | case q e e1 e2 =>
        cLet q
            (translateTerm e)
            (cCase q (var_Val var_zero)
                ((ren_Comp up_ren') (translateTerm e1))
                ((ren_Comp up_ren') (translateTerm e2)))
    | box q e =>
        let q' := q_or_1 q in
        cLet q (translateTerm e)
             (cRet Qone (vThunk (cRet q' (var_Val var_zero))))
    | unbox q e1 e2 =>
        cLet q
            (translateTerm e1)
            (cLet q
                    (cForce (var_Val var_zero))
                    ((ren_Comp up_ren') (translateTerm e2)))
    | ret e => cRet Qone (vThunk (translateTerm e))
    | bind q e1 e2 =>
        cRet Qone (vThunk
            (cLet q (cLet Qone (translateTerm e1) (cForce (var_Val var_zero)))
            (cLet Qone (translateTerm e2)
            (cForce (var_Val var_zero)))))
    | coerce e =>
        cRet Qone (vThunk (cLet Qone (translateTerm e) (cForce (var_Val var_zero))))
    | tickT => cRet Qone (vThunk (cLet Qone cTick (cRet Qone (var_Val var_zero))))
    end.

Require Export cbpv.autosubst2.axioms.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Unset Strict Implicit.

Definition ap {X Y} (f : X -> Y) {x y : X} (p : x = y) : f x = f y :=
  match p with eq_refl => eq_refl end.

Definition apc {X Y} {f g : X -> Y} {x y : X} (p : f = g) (q : x = y) : f x = g y :=
  match q with eq_refl => match p with eq_refl => eq_refl end end.

Fixpoint fin (n : nat) : Type :=
  match n with
  | 0 => False
  | S m => option (fin m)
  end.

Definition ren (m n : nat) : Type := fin m -> fin n.

Definition id {X} (x : X) := x.

Definition idren {k: nat} : ren k k :=
  fun x => x.

Definition var_zero {n : nat} : fin (S n) := None.

Definition null {T} (i : fin 0) : T := match i with end.

Definition shift {n : nat} : ren n (S n) :=
  Some.

Definition comp := @funcomp.

Definition scons {X : Type} {n : nat} (x : X) (f : fin n -> X) (m : fin (S n)) : X :=
  match m with
  | None => x
  | Some i => f i
  end.

Class Ren1 (X1  : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=
  ren1 : X1 -> Y -> Z.

Class Ren2 (X1 X2 : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=
  ren2 : X1 -> X2 -> Y -> Z.

Class Ren3 (X1 X2 X3 : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=
  ren3 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 -> Y -> Z.

Class Ren4 (X1 X2 X3 X4 : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=
  ren4 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 -> X4 -> Y -> Z.

Class Ren5 (X1 X2 X3 X4 X5 : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=
  ren5 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 -> X4 -> X5 -> Y -> Z.

Declare Scope fscope.

Declare Scope subst_scope.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Definition ap {X Y} (f : X -> Y) {x y : X} (p : x = y) : f x = f y :=
  match p with eq_refl => eq_refl end.

Definition apc {X Y} {f g : X -> Y} {x y : X} (p : f = g) (q : x = y) : f x = g y :=
  match q with eq_refl => match p with eq_refl => eq_refl end end.

Fixpoint fin (n : nat) : Type :=
  match n with
  | 0 => False
  | S m => option (fin m)
  end.

Definition ren (m n : nat) : Type := fin m -> fin n.

Definition id {X} (x : X) := x.

Definition idren {k: nat} : ren k k :=
  fun x => x.

Definition var_zero {n : nat} : fin (S n) := None.

Definition null {T} (i : fin 0) : T := match i with end.

  Some.

Definition scons {X : Type} {n : nat} (x : X) (f : fin n -> X) (m : fin (S n)) : X :=
  match m with
  | None => x
  | Some i => f i
  end.

From Coq Require Import FunctionalExtensionality.

(* decidable equality on fin *)
Definition Some_inj {n} {i j : fin n} (H : Some i = Some j) : i = j :=
  match H in (_ = y) return (match y with None => True | Some k => i = k end) with
  | eq_refl => eq_refl
  end.

Fixpoint fin_eq_dec {n} : forall (i j : fin n), {i = j} + {i <> j} :=
  match n as k return forall (i j : fin k), {i = j} + {i <> j} with
  | 0 => fun i => match i with end
  | S k => fun i j =>
      match i as a return forall (j : fin (S k)), {a = j} + {a <> j} with
      | None => fun j =>
          match j as b return {None = b} + {None <> b} with
          | None => left eq_refl
          | Some _ => right (fun H => match H with end)
          end
      | Some i' => fun j =>
          match j as b return {Some i' = b} + {Some i' <> b} with
          | None => right (fun H => match H with end)
          | Some j' =>
              match fin_eq_dec i' j' with
              | left H => left (f_equal (@Some k) H)
              | right H => right (fun E => H (Some_inj E))
              end
          end
      end j
  end.

Check fin_eq_dec.
Eval compute in (fin_eq_dec (n:=3) (Some None) (Some None)).
Eval compute in (fin_eq_dec (n:=3) (Some None) None).

(* find preimage *)
Fixpoint find_preimage {n m} (ξ : fin n -> fin m) (j : fin m) : option (fin n) :=
  match n as k return (fin k -> fin m) -> option (fin k) with
  | 0 => fun _ => None
  | S k => fun ξ =>
      match fin_eq_dec (ξ None) j with
      | left _ => Some None
      | right _ =>
          match find_preimage (fun i => ξ (Some i)) j with
          | Some i => Some (Some i)
          | None => None
          end
      end
  end ξ.

Definition grade_ren {n m} (ξ : fin n -> fin m) (γ : gradeVec n) : gradeVec m :=
  fun j => match find_preimage ξ j with
           | Some i => γ i
           | None => Qzero
           end.

Lemma find_preimage_sound : forall {n m} (ξ : fin n -> fin m) j i,
  find_preimage ξ j = Some i -> ξ i = j.
Proof.
  intros n. induction n as [|k IH]; intros m ξ j i H.
  - simpl in H. discriminate.
  - simpl in H. destruct (fin_eq_dec (ξ None) j) as [e|e].
    + inversion H; subst. exact e.
    + destruct (find_preimage (fun i => ξ (Some i)) j) as [i'|] eqn:E; try discriminate.
      inversion H; subst. apply IH in E. exact E.
Qed.

Lemma find_preimage_complete : forall {n m} (ξ : fin n -> fin m) j,
  (forall i, ξ i <> j) -> find_preimage ξ j = None.
Proof.
  intros n. induction n as [|k IH]; intros m ξ j H.
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (fin_eq_dec (ξ None) j) as [e|e].
    + exfalso; apply (H None); exact e.
    + apply IH; intro i; apply H.
Qed.

Proof.

  - destruct i as [|i'].

    + simpl. destruct (fin_eq_dec (ξ None) (ξ (Some i'))) as [e|e].
      * exfalso. apply (Hinj None (Some i')) in e. discriminate.
      * apply IH; [| exact i'].
        intros a b Hab. apply Hinj in Hab. inversion Hab. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma find_preimage_some : forall {n m} (ξ : fin n -> fin m) j,

Lemma find_preimage_sound : forall {n m} (ξ : fin n -> fin m) j i,
  find_preimage ξ j = Some i -> ξ i = j.
Proof.
  intros n. induction n as [|k IH]; intros m ξ j i H.

    + inversion H; subst. exact e.

  (forall i, ξ i <> j) -> find_preimage ξ j = None.
Proof.

        -- right; intro H; apply e; injection H; auto.
      * right; discriminate.
    + destruct j.
      * right; discriminate.
      * left; reflexivity.

(* find preimage *)
Fixpoint find_preimage {n m} (ξ : fin n -> fin m) (j : fin m) : option (fin n) :=
  match n as k return (fin k -> fin m) -> option (fin k) with
  | 0 => fun _ => None
  | S k => fun ξ =>
      match fin_eq_dec (ξ None) j with
      | left _ => Some None
      | right _ =>
          match find_preimage (fun i => ξ (Some i)) j with
          | Some i => Some (Some i)
          | None => None
          end
      end
  end ξ.

Definition grade_ren {n m} (ξ : fin n -> fin m) (γ : gradeVec n) : gradeVec m :=
  fun j => match find_preimage ξ j with
           | Some i => γ i
           | None => Qzero
           end.

Lemma find_preimage_sound : forall {n m} (ξ : fin n -> fin m) j i,
  find_preimage ξ j = Some i -> ξ i = j.
Proof.
  intros n. induction n as [|k IH]; intros m ξ j i H.
  - simpl in H. discriminate.
  - simpl in H. destruct (fin_eq_dec (ξ None) j) as [e|e].
    + inversion H; subst. exact e.
    + destruct (find_preimage (fun i => ξ (Some i)) j) as [i'|] eqn:E; try discriminate.
      inversion H; subst. apply IH in E. exact E.
Qed.

Lemma find_preimage_image : forall {n m} (ξ : fin n -> fin m) i,
  ren_inj ξ -> find_preimage ξ (ξ i) = Some i.
Proof.
  intros n. induction n as [|k IH]; intros m ξ i Hinj.
  - destruct i.
  - destruct i as [i'|].
    + simpl. destruct (fin_eq_dec (ξ None) (ξ (Some i'))) as [e|e].

      * apply IH.
        -- intros a b Hab. apply Hinj in Hab. inversion Hab. reflexivity.
        -- exact i'.
    + simpl. destruct (fin_eq_dec (ξ None) (ξ None)) as [e|e].
      * reflexivity.
      * exfalso; apply e; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma find_preimage_some : forall {n m} (ξ : fin n -> fin m) j,
  find_preimage (fun i => Some (ξ i)) (Some j) =
  match find_preimage ξ j with Some i => Some (Some i) | None => None end.
Proof.
  intros n. induction n as [|k IH]; intros m ξ j.
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (fin_eq_dec (ξ None) j) as [e|e].
    + reflexivity.
    + simpl. apply IH.
Qed.

Lemma grade_ren_add : forall {n m} (ξ : fin n -> fin m) (γ1 γ2 : gradeVec n),
  grade_ren ξ (γ1 Q+ γ2) = grade_ren ξ γ1 Q+ grade_ren ξ γ2.
Proof.
  intros. apply funext. intro j. unfold grade_ren, gradeVecAdd.
  destruct (find_preimage ξ j); reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma grade_ren_scale : forall {n m} (ξ : fin n -> fin m) q (γ : gradeVec n),
  grade_ren ξ (q Q* γ) = q Q* grade_ren ξ γ.
Proof.
  intros. apply funext. intro j. unfold grade_ren, gradeVecScale.
  destruct (find_preimage ξ j).
  - reflexivity.
  - symmetry. apply Qzero_rannihilates.
Qed.

Lemma grade_ren_zero : forall {n m} (ξ : fin n -> fin m),
  grade_ren ξ (0s : gradeVec n) = 0s.
Proof. intros. apply funext. intro j. unfold grade_ren. destruct (find_preimage ξ j); reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma grade_ren_le : forall {n m} (ξ : fin n -> fin m) (γ1 γ2 : gradeVec n),
  γ1 Q<= γ2 -> grade_ren ξ γ1 Q<= grade_ren ξ γ2.
Proof.
  intros n m ξ γ1 γ2 H j. unfold grade_ren. destruct (find_preimage ξ j).
  - apply H.
  - apply Qle_refl.
Qed.

Lemma grade_ren_up : forall {n m} (ξ : fin n -> fin m) (q : Q) (γ : gradeVec n),
  grade_ren (up_ren ξ) (q .: γ) = q .: grade_ren ξ γ.
Proof.
  intros. apply funext. intro j. destruct j as [j0|].
  - unfold grade_ren, up_ren, scons. simpl.

  - unfold grade_ren, up_ren, scons, var_zero. simpl.

Qed.

  grade_ren (@shift n n) γ = Qzero .: γ.
Proof.
  intros. apply funext. intro j. destruct j as [j0|].
  - unfold grade_ren, shift. simpl. reflexivity.
  - unfold grade_ren, shift. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma GradeRen_add : forall {n m} (ρ : fin n -> fin m) (G : gradeVec n -> gradeVec m),
  GradeRen ρ G -> forall γ1 γ2, G (γ1 Q+ γ2) = G γ1 Q+ G γ2.
Proof. intros n m ρ G [H _]. exact H. Qed.
Lemma GradeRen_scale : forall {n m} (ρ : fin n -> fin m) (G : gradeVec n -> gradeVec m),
  GradeRen ρ G -> forall q γ, G (q Q* γ) = q Q* G γ.
Proof. intros n m ρ G [_ [H _]]. exact H. Qed.
Lemma GradeRen_le : forall {n m} (ρ : fin n -> fin m) (G : gradeVec n -> gradeVec m),
  GradeRen ρ G -> forall γ1 γ2, γ1 Q<= γ2 -> G γ1 Q<= G γ2.
Proof. intros n m ρ G [_ [_ [H _]]]. exact H. Qed.
Lemma GradeRen_zero : forall {n m} (ρ : fin n -> fin m) (G : gradeVec n -> gradeVec m),
  GradeRen ρ G -> G (0s) = 0s.
Proof. intros n m ρ G [_ [_ [_ [H _]]]]. exact H. Qed.
Lemma GradeRen_var : forall {n m} (ρ : fin n -> fin m) (G : gradeVec n -> gradeVec m),
  GradeRen ρ G -> forall γ i, γ i = Qone -> (forall j, j <> i -> γ j = Qzero) ->
    G γ (ρ i) = Qone /\ (forall j, j <> ρ i -> G γ j = Qzero).

Lemma ren_Wt_mutual :
  (forall n γ Γ V A, VWt γ Γ V A ->

Lemma ctx_cons : forall {n} (T : Ty) (Γ : contextL n),
  translateContext (T .: Γ) = translateType T .: translateContext Γ.
Proof. intros. apply functional_extensionality. intros [i|]; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma wt_var_one : forall {n} (A B : ValTy) (Γ : context n),
  VWt (Qzero .: (Qone .: (0s : gradeVec n))) (B .: (A .: Γ)) (var_Val (shift var_zero)) A.
Proof.
  intros n A B Γ.
  refine (@T_Var (S (S n)) (Qzero .: (Qone .: 0s)) (B .: (A .: Γ)) (shift var_zero) _ _).
  - reflexivity.
  - intros [j|] Hj.
    + destruct j as [j1|].
      * reflexivity.
      * exfalso; apply Hj; reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
Qed.

Theorem cbv_translation_correct :
    forall n (γ : gradeVec n) (Γ : contextL n) e T,

    CWt γ (translateContext Γ) (translateTerm e) (CF Qone (translateType T)) ϵ.

  | n γ Γ q q' e0 T1 T2 Hp IH Hle
  | n γ Γ q q' e1 e2 T1 T2 γ1 γ2 qeq H1 IH1 H2 IH2 eeq
  | n γ Γ eeq
  | n γ Γ e1 e2 T0 γ1 γ2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 eeq
  | n γ Γ e1 e2 T1 T2 γ1 γ2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 eeq
  | n γ Γ q q' e1 e2 T1 T2 γ1 γ2 qeq H1 IH1 H2 IH2 eeq
  | n γ Γ e0 T1 T2 Hp IH
  | n γ Γ e0 T1 T2 Hp IH
  | n γ Γ q e0 e1 e2 T1 T2 T0 γ1 γ2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 H3 IH3 eeq Hle
  | n γ Γ q q' e0 T0 γ1 qeq Hp IH eeq
  | n γ Γ q1 q2 q2' e1 e2 T1 T2 γ1 γ2 qeq H1 IH1 H2 IH2 eeq
  | n γ Γ e0 T0 γ' Hp IH Hle
  | n γ Γ e0 T0 ϕ Hp IH phieq
  | n γ Γ q' q e1 e2 T1 T2 γ1 γ2 ϕ1 ϕ2 ϕ qeq H1 IH1 H2 IH2 eeq effeq
  | n γ Γ e0 T0 ϕ ϕ' Hp IH Hsub
  | n γ Γ eeq

## Summary

`/workspace/Task.v` now proves both targets with no `Admitted`/`admit`/`Abort`/new axioms.

**Proof architecture**

1. **Grade-renaming machinery** (top level). CBPV typing is stable under renaming, but its graded rules mean the grade vector must be transformed along with the renamer. I packaged the transformation as `GradeRen ρ G` (additivity, scaling, monotonicity, zero, and variable/unit behaviour), with `G_shift γ = Qzero .: γ` for the weakening renamer and `grade_up G` for going under a binder. `GradeRen_up : GradeRen ρ G → GradeRen (up_ren ρ) (grade_up G)` lets the renaming lemma lift under binders.

2. **Mutual renaming lemma** `ren_Wt_mutual_conj` for `VWt`/`CWt`, proved by `Wt_mutual`. It handles all 22 CBPV rules, including the tricky `T_App`/`T_Split`/`T_Let`/`T_Case`/`T_LetZero` cases.

3. **Resource facts** from the supplied POSR axioms: `q_or_1` is never zero, is idempotent, and equals `q` whenever `q ≠ 0`; crucially `Qle Qzero Qone` is *refutable* from `Qsumzero`/`Qnontrivial`, so the `Qle q Qone` premises of `case`/`split` force `q ≠ 0` — which is exactly what makes the `q_or_1` in the translations line up with the source grades. Also vector arithmetic (`Qone Q* γ = γ`, cons/add/scale rules).

4. **The two correctness theorems**, by induction on the source `Wt` derivation, using the renaming lemma for each embedded `ren_Comp shift` / `up_ren'` / `up2_ren'`, and the resource lemmas to discharge every grade/effect side condition. The CBN translation needs renaming only at `seq` and `case`; CBV needs it at `app`, `seq`, `pair`, `split`, `unbox`, `case`, and `bind`.

The target statements and names are unchanged, and the only edited file is `Task.v`.
